question.text: For any non-zero complex number $z$, the minimum value of $|z|+|z-1|$ is

solution.text:
$|z|+|z-1| a$ is complex number
$$
\begin{array}{c}
|z|+|-(1-z)| \quad|a|=|-a| \\
|z|+|1-z| \quad\{\because|a|=|-a|\} \\
|z|+|1-z| \geq|z+1-z| \\
|z|+|1-z| \geq|1| \\
|z|+|1-z| \geq 1 \\
|z|+|-(z-1)| \geq 1 \\
|z|+|z-1| \geq 1
\end{array}
$$
Minimum value of $|z|+|z-1|=1$
